title: Plant your roots and come grow with us!
intro: Our salon home is growing and we are always looking for wellness-minded people to join our team. More than anything we have an amazing group of girls who genuinely support, encourage, celebrate, and pray for one another. If you are looking for a salon that values community over competition, and are looking to detox your work environment, we’d love to meet you!
offer: We offer both commission and booth rental opportunities.
commission: Social media coaching and content support
Choice and support in continuing education
boothRental: Prorated daily rates for part time stylists

stylistQuotes.quote: I love working in an atmosphere where I feel seen, heard, and supported. Where the goal is to grow each stylist!
stylistQuotes.name: Ashley

stylistQuotes.quote: As a Christian, my faith is an important part of who I am and I'm grateful to work in an environment where those values are appreciated.
stylistQuotes.name: Bridgette
